an4.36:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā antarā ca Ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca Setabbyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.36:1.2: Doṇo pi sudaṃ brāhmaṇo antarā ca Ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca Setabbyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.36:1.3: Addasā kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato padesu cakkāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni
an4.36:1.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
an4.36:1.6: na vat' imāni manussabhūtassa padāni bhavissantīti. 2.
an4.36:1.7: Atha kho Bhagavā maggā ukkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an4.36:1.8: Atha kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato padāni anugacchanto addasā Bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadammathasamatham anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ santindriyaṃ nāgaṃ
an4.36:1.9: disvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.36:2.2: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa devo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.4: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa gandhabbo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.6: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa yakkho bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.8: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa manusso bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:3.1: Devo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.2: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa devo bhavissāmīti vadesi,
an4.36:3.3: gandhabbo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.4: na kho ahaṃ gandhabbo bhavissāmīti vadesi,
an4.36:3.7: manusso no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.8: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa manusso bhavissāmīti vadesi,
an4.36:3.9: atha kho ko carahi bhavaṃ bhavissatīti? 3.
an4.36:4.1: Yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ appahīnattā devo bhaveyyaṃ te me āsavā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
an4.36:4.2: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ appahīnattā gandhabbo bhaveyyaṃ yakkho bhaveyyaṃ manusso bhaveyyaṃ te me āsavā pahīnā . . . anuppādadhammā.
an4.36:4.3: Seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakaṃ accuggamma ṭhāti anupalittaṃ udakena,
an4.36:4.4: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharāmi anupalitto lokena.
